# FiberCare Cleaning & Restoration

> Family-owned cleaning & restoration company in Louisville, KY since 1993. IICRC-certified technicians, 5.0-star Google rating. 24/7 water damage emergency response: (502) 491-1242.

## Services
- [Water Damage Restoration](https://fibercareky.com/water-damage-restoration/): 24/7 emergency response for floods, burst pipes and leaks. Rapid extraction, structural drying and mold prevention — every hour counts.
- [Mold Remediation](https://fibercareky.com/mold-remediation/): Safe, thorough mold inspection, removal and prevention. We find the source, remove the mold and stop it coming back.
- [Carpet Cleaning](https://fibercareky.com/carpet-cleaning/): Truck-mounted hot water extraction — the method carpet manufacturers recommend. Deep clean, honest pricing, eco-safe products.
- [Upholstery Cleaning](https://fibercareky.com/upholstery-cleaning/): Fabric-code-aware cleaning for sofas, sectionals and chairs — including fabrics that cannot go to a dry cleaner.
- [Tile & Grout Cleaning](https://fibercareky.com/tile-grout-cleaning/): High-pressure professional cleaning that gets inside grout lines household products can't touch — sealed afterward to stay cleaner longer.
- [Hardwood Floor Cleaning](https://fibercareky.com/hardwood-floor-cleaning/): Controlled-moisture deep cleaning calibrated for hardwood and engineered wood — a deep clean without the warping risk.
